# IETF
> The Internet Engineering Task Force develops and publishes open Internet standards, including RFCs, protocols, and operational guidance.

The IETF website provides standards process documentation, working group information, meeting materials, Datatracker tools, RFC publication resources, and related governance and administration information for the Internet standards community.

## About the IETF
- [About](https://www.ietf.org/about/): Overview of the IETF, its role, structure, and standards development activities.
- [Introduction to the IETF](https://www.ietf.org/about/introduction/): Introductory guide to the IETF’s mission, principles, participants, and work.
- [Participants](https://www.ietf.org/about/introduction/#participants): Explains who participates in the IETF and how contributions are made.
- [Mission](https://www.ietf.org/about/introduction/#mission): Describes the IETF mission and scope in Internet standards development.
- [Principles](https://www.ietf.org/about/introduction/#principles): Summarizes the core principles guiding IETF standards work and collaboration.
- [The work](https://www.ietf.org/about/introduction/#work): Explains how technical work is organized and progressed within the IETF.

## Leadership, Groups, and Related Bodies
- [Internet Engineering Steering Group](https://www.ietf.org/about/groups/iesg/): Information about the IESG and its role in technical management.
- [Internet Architecture Board](https://www.ietf.org/about/groups/iab/): Overview of the IAB and its architectural and oversight responsibilities.
- [Internet Research Task Force](https://www.ietf.org/about/groups/irtf/): Describes the IRTF and its long-term Internet research activities.
- [Nominating Committee](https://www.ietf.org/about/groups/nomcom/): Information about the NomCom process for selecting IETF leadership.
- [IETF Trust](https://www.ietf.org/about/groups/trust/): Details on the IETF Trust and intellectual property administration.
- [RFC Editor](https://www.ietf.org/about/groups/rfc-editor/): Overview of the RFC Editor function and publication responsibilities.
- [Independent Submissions Editor](https://www.ietf.org/about/groups/ise/): Information about the independent stream for RFC submissions.
- [Liaison relationships](https://www.ietf.org/about/liaisons/): Describes formal liaison relationships with other organizations.

## Standards Process and Policies
- [Standards Process](https://www.ietf.org/standards/process/): Entry point for IETF standards process documentation and procedures.
- [BCP 9: The Internet Standards Process](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/bcp9): Canonical reference for the Internet Standards Process.
- [Intellectual Property](https://www.ietf.org/standards/ipr/): Information about IETF IPR rules, disclosures, and related procedures.
- [Note Well](https://www.ietf.org/about/note-well/): Participation notice covering contribution rules, IPR, and expected conduct.
- [Anti-Harassment Procedures](https://www.ietf.org/about/anti-harassment-and-anti-discrimination/): Policy and procedures for anti-harassment and anti-discrimination in the community.
- [Tao of the IETF](https://www.ietf.org/about/participate/tao/): Practical guide for understanding IETF culture, process, and participation.

## Participation and Community
- [Participate](https://www.ietf.org/participate/): Central hub for joining IETF work, meetings, and mailing lists.
- [New Participant Program](https://www.ietf.org/participate/newcomers/): Resources for first-time participants learning how to engage effectively.
- [Meetings](https://www.ietf.org/how/meetings/): Information about IETF meetings, formats, agendas, and participation options.
- [Working Groups](https://www.ietf.org/how/wgs/): Explains how working groups are formed and how they operate.
- [Email Lists](https://www.ietf.org/mailman/listinfo/): Access point for IETF mailing lists used for technical discussion.
- [Code of Conduct](https://www.ietf.org/about/code-of-conduct/): Community expectations for respectful and professional participation.

## Datatracker and Tools
- [Datatracker](https://datatracker.ietf.org/): Primary tool for tracking drafts, RFCs, groups, meetings, and ballots.
- [Documents](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/): Browse Internet-Drafts, RFCs, and document metadata in Datatracker.
- [Working Groups](https://datatracker.ietf.org/wg/): Directory of IETF working groups and their current status.
- [Meetings](https://datatracker.ietf.org/meeting/): Meeting agendas, proceedings, materials, and session information.
- [IESG State](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/iesg/): Tracks documents under IESG evaluation and related actions.
- [Search IETF Datatracker](https://datatracker.ietf.org/search): Search across Datatracker records and document metadata.

## RFCs and Internet-Drafts
- [RFC Editor](https://www.rfc-editor.org/): Home of the RFC series and publication resources.
- [RFC Search](https://www.rfc-editor.org/search): Search published RFCs by number, title, author, or keyword.
- [RFC Index](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc-index.html): Index of all published RFCs and their current status.
- [Internet-Drafts](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/internet-drafts/): Browse active Internet-Drafts under development in the IETF.
- [RFC Format and Style](https://www.rfc-editor.org/styleguide/): Guidance on RFC editorial conventions, formatting, and style.
- [Authors' Center](https://www.rfc-editor.org/authors/): Resources for authors preparing documents for RFC publication.

## Meetings and Events
- [Upcoming Meetings](https://www.ietf.org/how/meetings/upcoming/): Schedule and information for upcoming IETF meetings and events.
- [IETF 126 Vienna](https://www.ietf.org/how/meetings/126/): Meeting information, agenda, and logistics for IETF 126.
- [IETF 127 San Francisco](https://www.ietf.org/how/meetings/127/): Meeting information, agenda, and logistics for IETF 127.
- [Meeting Materials](https://datatracker.ietf.org/meeting/materials): Access slides, minutes, agendas, and proceedings from meetings.
- [Meeting Proceedings](https://www.ietf.org/how/meetings/proceedings/): Archive of proceedings and materials from past IETF meetings.
- [Hackathons](https://www.ietf.org/how/runningcode/hackathons/): Information about IETF hackathons and implementation-focused events.

## Administration and Legal
- [IETF Administration LLC](https://www.ietf.org/administration/overview/): Overview of the administrative entity supporting IETF operations.
- [Administrative announcements](https://www.ietf.org/administration/announcements/): Official administrative updates and operational announcements.
- [Legal request procedures](https://www.ietf.org/administration/legal-request-procedures/): Procedures for submitting legal requests involving the IETF.
- [Legal requests](https://www.ietf.org/administration/legal-requests/): Information and records related to legal requests.
- [Policies and Governance](https://www.ietf.org/administration/policies-procedures/): Administrative policies, procedures, and governance documentation.
- [Finances and Budget](https://www.ietf.org/administration/finances/): Budget, financial reporting, and related administrative information.

## News, Archives, and Search
- [News](https://www.ietf.org/blog/): News, announcements, and updates from the IETF community.
- [IETF email archive](https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/): Searchable archive of IETF mailing list discussions.
- [Search the IETF email archive](https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/search/): Search interface for archived mailing list messages.
- [Internet-Draft announcements](https://www.ietf.org/mail-archive/ietf-announce/): Archive of IETF-wide announcement messages.
- [RFC Errata](https://www.rfc-editor.org/errata.php): Search and review reported errata for published RFCs.
- [Site search](https://www.ietf.org/search/): Search across content on the IETF website.
